item.title: Riyadh Airport Begins Biggest Overhaul In 40 Years With Terminal Reshuffle
item.description: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has begun implementing its largest operational transformation since opening more than 40 years ago, marking the first comprehensive overhaul of airline operations across its terminals. The phased redistribution came into effect today. item.title: Omanis Granted One-Year Visa-Free Entry To Azerbaijan
item.description: Omani citizens have been granted visa-free entry to Azerbaijan for one year starting February 15, 2026, Oman’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said. Under the temporary exemption, which runs until February 15, 2027, Omani nationals may enter Azerbaijan without obtaining a prior visa and stay for up to 30 days per visit. The arrangement allows a maximum of three visits within one year. The ministry advised travellers to ensure their passports are valid for at least six months from the date of entry.
